title: Event participation consent
body:
Please review the event information and published programme before agreeing.

I agree to participate, or give permission for the attendee named on this form to participate, in the event's scheduled activities that are appropriate for that attendee. I will follow organizer instructions, respect other participants and venue rules, and report concerns to event staff. Activities requiring separate permission, including sports and off-site trips, are covered by their own forms.

I will provide accurate registration and emergency-contact information and tell the organizing team about changes that affect safe participation. I understand that event registration and this consent do not replace activity eligibility checks or Junior Platform pickup verification.

I understand that relevant event staff will use this form to administer participation. If I have questions about the programme or this form, I will contact the organizer before signing.

title: Food and dietary information
body:
Tell the event team about the named attendee's dietary preferences and food allergies so they can discuss suitable arrangements with you.

Submitting this form does not confirm that a particular meal or allergen-free preparation is available. Please contact the organizer or catering lead to confirm arrangements before relying on the meal service. Tell them if this information changes.

For an attendee with an existing allergy emergency plan, arrange to share that plan directly with the designated event contact and discuss who will support the attendee. This form is not an emergency-response service. During an emergency, contact event staff and the local emergency services immediately.

Relevant event administrators will use the information to coordinate meal arrangements. Please provide only information needed for that purpose.

questions.label: Food allergies (enter None if none known)
Arrangements you would like to discuss with the catering team
Contact name and telephone for follow-up

title: Sports participation consent
body:
Review the organizer's description of the sports activity, location, supervision and participation requirements before signing.

I agree to participate, or give permission for the named attendee to participate, in the sports activity identified below. I understand that physical activity can involve falls, collisions or other injury. The attendee will follow staff instructions, use the required equipment, and stop and tell a supervisor if they feel unwell, uncomfortable or injured.

I will tell the activity lead about relevant participation restrictions and confirm any necessary arrangements before the activity begins. This consent does not establish medical fitness or replace any clearance the organizer requires.

For a child, I will remain reachable during the activity and follow the event's drop-off and authorized-pickup process. If I need to withdraw permission, I will contact the organizer before participation.

questions.label: Sports activity covered by this consent
Participation restrictions to discuss with the activity lead (or None)

title: Junior Platform participation consent
body:
I am the parent or legal guardian of the child named on this form and give permission for their participation in the published, age-appropriate Junior Platform programme. I will review the schedule, supervision arrangements and any separate activity requirements with the organizer.

I will complete the required check-in and checkout process. Only people authorized under the event's pickup arrangements may collect the child, using the required identity or pass verification. Permission to collect a child is separate from permission to sign this form.

I will remain reachable, provide accurate emergency-contact information, and inform staff of relevant support needs. I will discuss any necessary arrangements with the Junior Platform lead before leaving the child in their care.

This permission covers the on-site Junior Platform programme. Sports or off-site trips that require separate consent must be approved using their own forms. I will contact the organizer if I need to change or withdraw permission.

questions.label: Alternative emergency contact name and telephone
Support needs to discuss with the Junior Platform lead (or None)

title: Field-trip permission
body:
The organizer must provide the trip's destination, date, departure and return times, transport arrangements, supervision and emergency contact before requesting signatures. Please confirm those details before signing.

I give permission for the named attendee to take part in the specific trip identified below. The attendee will follow the trip leader's instructions and remain with the assigned group. I will discuss relevant participation or accessibility needs with the organizer beforehand.

For a child, I will remain reachable and follow the designated handoff and pickup arrangements. The child may be released only through the event's authorized-pickup process. If plans change materially, the organizer should provide updated information and obtain fresh permission.

I will contact the organizer before departure if I need to withdraw permission. This form does not cover other trips or grant general travel permission.

questions.label: Departure/return times and transport arrangements reviewed
Participation or accessibility needs to discuss (or None)
